summary: Sending to ServiceNow is much faster, and you can follow its progress.

new.title: Follow ServiceNow send progress
new.text: While it sends, you see the phase, rows sent of rows planned, rows held and time left. A send without progress for 10 minutes says so.

fixes.title: Vulnerable items built three times faster
fixes.text: Vulnerable items for ServiceNow are now built about three times faster. On large installs, the pass over closed findings takes hours less, with the same rows sent.

fixes.title: Refused sends are reported at once
fixes.text: When ServiceNow refuses or holds a send, SecurityInsight says so at once and stops. Nothing is counted as sent that was not.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: The install always identifies itself to Invardia the same way, and shows its hand-off progress in its status.
